section.title: Selected work
section.subtitle: Production backends, payment rails, operational tooling and quant systems I have designed, built and run.

projects.title: Real-time liquidity and reconciliation system
projects.problem: [CHECK] Customer withdrawals across wallets, blockchain accounts and external payment providers risked failing whenever liquidity or ledger balances drifted out of sync between rails.
projects.built: I designed a real-time liquidity and transaction reconciliation system across internal wallets, blockchain accounts and payment providers, paired with automated webhook and ledger verification workflows.
projects.result: I reduced failed customer withdrawals to under 0.1% and kept multi-provider balances continuously reconciled in production.

diagram.caption: Real-time balance checks, ledger matching and withdrawal settlement flow

projects.title: Cross-chain blockchain infrastructure
projects.problem: [CHECK] Processing cross-chain transactions across Stellar, Solana, Ethereum and TRON required fault-tolerant signing, routing and on-chain finality monitoring that would not drop transactions under load.
projects.built: I built and maintained Rust-based blockchain infrastructure for wallet management, transaction signing and on-chain finality monitoring across Stellar, Solana, Ethereum and TRON.
projects.result: I achieved 99.9% production uptime while processing over $1M in cross-chain transactions over an 8-month period.

diagram.caption: Cross-chain transaction signing, routing and finality verification flow

projects.title: Agent Banking backend
projects.problem: A liquidity shortage made direct customer transactions harder to fulfil through standard payment rails alone.
projects.built: I designed and launched an Agent Banking backend feature that enabled local agents to facilitate customer transactions during the liquidity shortage, including agent wallet funding and settlement workflows.
projects.result: I kept customer transactions moving through the shortage and created a new transaction-based revenue channel for the business.

diagram.caption: Agent-assisted customer transaction routing and commission settlement flow

projects.title: Pan-African fiat on/off-ramp and payment APIs
projects.problem: [CHECK] Running fiat on-ramps, off-ramps and card products across five African countries required unifying multiple payment providers with different webhook and settlement flows behind fast, reliable APIs.
projects.built: I designed and implemented scalable backend services supporting 4,000+ active users with sub-200ms API response times, integrating Flutterwave, Link and Bridge alongside card and wallet funding workflows.
projects.result: I enabled fiat on-ramp and off-ramp flows across five African countries while keeping API response times under 200ms.

diagram.caption: Multi-provider fiat on/off-ramp request and webhook settlement pipeline

projects.title: Crypto infrastructure telemetry dashboard
projects.problem: [CHECK] Stakeholders needed clear, live visibility into transaction volume and infrastructure activity across blockchain networks without querying raw logs or production databases.
projects.built: I built an internal crypto infrastructure dashboard that aggregates on-chain transaction volume and network activity across supported blockchain rails.
projects.result: I gave stakeholders real-time visibility into cross-chain transaction volume and infrastructure health to support daily operations.

diagram.caption: On-chain indexer aggregation and live stakeholder telemetry readout

projects.title: ClickHouse market data pipeline and exchange fallback
projects.problem: [CHECK] Strategy validation and live quant models needed months of historical Forex and crypto data plus uninterrupted live price feeds that could survive single-exchange outages.
projects.built: I designed a high-performance data pipeline to synchronise 5+ months of historical Forex and crypto data into ClickHouse, and built a multi-exchange price fallback layer across Coinbase, Kraken, Bitfinex and Binance.
projects.result: I enabled rapid strategy validation and parameter optimisation while improving live market-data availability and resilience.

diagram.caption: Multi-exchange market feed ingestion, failover routing and ClickHouse storage

projects.title: Weighted probability engine and risk controls
projects.problem: [CHECK] Capturing short-lived arbitrage edges in prediction markets required accurate real-time probability estimation while protecting against sudden price wicks and end-of-hour reversals.
projects.built: I co-developed a high-frequency autonomous arbitrage system for prediction markets, developed a weighted probability engine for real-time statistical edge estimation, and implemented wick-detection filters and end-of-hour reversal stop-loss logic.
projects.result: I improved the simulated model win rate from 91% to 95%, reduced strategy drawdowns, and helped achieve a 190% ROI during March 2026 in simulated and live strategy environments.

diagram.caption: Real-time probability estimation, wick filtering and autonomous execution
